head: 31c647f61260811322a6800a4b37797ccb580e9b
review_kind: Static call-chain review of the actual merged source; no independent runtime reproduction or device check.
settled_writer_fix: Correct: successful forget clears the current conversation IDs.

remaining_finding.summary: A queued writer can restore deleted IDs before the next explicit remember copies them.
remaining_finding.end_marker: The forget path ignores try_send failure. Full queue can drop End; accepted End remains behind older work.
interleaving: A linked exchange is committed, but its writer has not processed the successful answer.
Successful forget deletes the linked item and exchanges, inhibits new journalling, and clears current.
The older writer publishes its private source list, including the deleted exchange.
A foreground remember copies that list before an accepted End executes, or while a full queue has dropped End. The store refuses the explicit memory request.
remaining_finding.existing_test_limit: The regression waits for append and sleeps 200 ms before forgetting; it does not hold a successful append across the clear or exercise a full queue.
requested_coverage: Fence pre-forget writer publications independently of End delivery.
Deterministically cover both accepted and full-queue End interleavings.

publication: Prepared follow-up remains local: CLI TLS handshake failure and connector comment permission denial prevent posting.
